themes.label: Pancakes and waffles
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly praise the pancakes and waffles, including chocolate, apple and bacon waffle versions, with several calling them among the best they have had.
quotes: I came here with no expectations and was blown away by the best pancakes that i ever had.
the chocolate ones were amazing. Definitely on par with the best and known spots in the city.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Many describe friendly, attentive staff, but others report slow, lousy or inattentive service and rude phone or manager behavior.
quotes: Service was great and friendly.
The food is really good and the place is cool but don't expect waiters that will take care of you.

themes.label: Lines and waiting
themes.text: Reviewers note long lines and crowding at brunch and peak times, though some say the line moves fast or is worth the wait.
quotes: Making it worse is the long line on the weekend one must endure for a mediocre meal.
The line was out the door for brunch but moved fast.

themes.label: Biscuits and strawberry butter
themes.text: Homemade biscuits with strawberry butter are singled out as a highlight of brunch.
quotes: The biscuits and strawberry butter make this place the best brunch on the Upper West Side.

themes.label: Stroller and kid policy
themes.text: Two reviewers say they were turned away because of a stroller and found the staff unwelcoming to families with children.
quotes: Refused to serve us because of stroller.

themes.label: Happy hour deals
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly praise the happy hour, especially the $1 oysters and clams, discounted drinks and small plates, though one misses the $1 oysters.
quotes: Awesome cheap happy hour from 5-7 with $1 oysters and clams!
Highly recommend their Oyster Happy Hour. 24 oysters for 30$ is just amazing

themes.label: Friendly attentive service
themes.text: Most reviewers describe staff as friendly, attentive and accommodating, including for late arrivals and birthdays, though one calls the host staff snotty and another felt unwelcome.
quotes: Waitress was excellent -very pleasant and attentive.
we were welcomed to come in no problem.

themes.label: Fresh seafood and oysters
themes.text: Fresh fish, oysters, lobster roll and clams are widely praised, but a few reviewers found oysters declining or tasteless and food too salty.
quotes: The lobster roll is to die for:) the oysters are briny and super fresh.
Good seafood but the quality of the oysters has decreased a lot within the past year

themes.label: Loud crowded room
themes.text: Some reviewers say the room is loud with closely spaced tables, and that it gets crowded with waits, especially on weekends and at happy hour.
quotes: the acoustic is bad so it's a very loud place. Tables are very close
Might be a long wait on the weekend though.

themes.label: Prices and portions
themes.text: Opinions differ: some find prices fair and portions generous, while others call it pricey or say portions are small.
quotes: you definitely get your money's worth from the amount of food in each dish
the portions seems kind of small to me

themes.label: Food quality and taste
themes.text: Most reviewers call the food delicious and fresh, but a sizeable minority found dishes bland, mediocre or poorly cooked.
quotes: Great for brunch. Food is delicious.
It was ok. Food was boring and tasteless

themes.label: Service
themes.text: Many describe friendly, attentive staff, but others report slow, rude, random or understaffed service.
quotes: Service was attentive but we never felt rushed.
Food is mediocre and service is incredibly slow.

themes.label: Vegan and vegetarian options
themes.text: Reviewers praise the wide choice of vegan, vegetarian and gluten-free dishes that suit mixed groups and families.
quotes: The vegan selection is wonderful, delicious choices!
Kids, adults, meat eaters and vegan. We were all thrilled with our meals.

themes.label: Atmosphere and space
themes.text: Reviewers describe a relaxed, comfortable, roomy setting with a patio and good music.
quotes: Delicious, fresh food in a open and comfortable atmosphere.
Quite nice place, playing good jazz all the time while having good food

themes.label: Prices and portions
themes.text: Some find prices reasonable and portions large, while others call the food overpriced for what it is.
quotes: prices are a bit high but portions are large so it's worth it.
Mediocre, overpriced and hyper/rude busboy.

themes.label: Burger quality
themes.text: Most reviewers call the burgers among the best in the area, praising juiciness and flavor, though a few found them dry, salty, or only average.
quotes: Excellent, juicy burgers with a lot of flavor!
burgers are just okay to pretty good IMO.

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Many describe friendly, attentive staff, but others report slow, inattentive or poor table service and order mistakes.
quotes: Attentive and kind service.
Wait staff very slow. Probably because there were too few of them

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Some find the prices high for what they get, while others call them reasonable or good value.
quotes: Tries to appear to be a chic fine dining place, but really it's just expensive, middle of the road burgers.

themes.label: Crowded and noisy room
themes.text: Reviewers describe the restaurant as crowded, loud and deafening at busy times, with long lines.
quotes: in a crowded, deafening environment this is the place!
Bring your earplugs and elbow pads.

themes.label: Sides and shakes
themes.text: Sweet potato fries, tater tots and milkshakes get frequent praise, though onion rings and regular fries were called unremarkable by some.
quotes: A weird hybrid of a crispy on the outside, mashed potatoes on the inside.
S'mores milkshake is delicious, nice consistency and flavor.

themes.label: Tacos and food quality
themes.text: Many praise the tacos, queso and churro dessert, while others found food bland, cold, mediocre or too small in portion.
quotes: The tacos are excellent: the Baja Fish and Al Pastor are particularly good.
the tacos are always served very cold and the chips taste like they are from the grocery store aisle

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Most reviewers describe attentive, friendly staff, but some report poor, hit-or-miss service, lost orders or trouble getting a server's attention.
quotes: Very attentive despite the number of people there.
Hit or miss both in terms of food and service. Service a miss more often then not.

themes.label: Noise and atmosphere
themes.text: Reviewers like the fun, lively vibe and seating, but several say the restaurant is very loud and crowded.
quotes: Amazing food. One of the loudest restaurants I've ever been in.
The atmosphere is great especially when the weather is nice and all the windows are open.

themes.label: Drinks and happy hour
themes.text: Margaritas, brunch cocktails and happy hour specials are often praised, though one reviewer found drinks pricey for the serving size.
quotes: The spicy margaritas are awesome, delicious appetizers as well.
the drinks were too pricey for the amount they serve

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Some find prices reasonable or decent, while others call the food pricey or overpriced for what it was.
quotes: Good and plentiful food. Reasonably priced for NYC
Honestly overpriced for what it was.

themes.label: Beer selection
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly praise a large, rotating craft beer list, including cask options, a tap board and a beer club, though one found it not wide.
quotes: They have rotating craft beers on tap - when you get your first, ask for a page in the "binder".

themes.label: Food, burgers and wings
themes.text: Burgers and wings get frequent praise, though a few reviewers found the bar food only average or disappointing.
quotes: Their double-fried wings are the best in the city.
Great beer selection. Food, eh...

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Most reviewers describe friendly, attentive staff, but a few report being ignored by bartenders or servers, or too little staffing.
quotes: Very friendly staff - makes it even better!
Server was more interested in talking with "regulars" than cultivating new business.

themes.label: Sports viewing
themes.text: The bar is described as a good place to watch sports, especially soccer and football games.
quotes: Good selection of beer and popcorn. Great for watching sports!
Very nice UWS spot for watching soccer.

themes.label: Free popcorn
themes.text: Free popcorn is mentioned as a welcome perk of the bar.
quotes: Free popcorn, great beer selection.
the free popcorn is great

themes.label: Low prices and value
themes.text: Many reviewers praise the food as cheap, affordable and good value, with generous portions, though a few call it overpriced or pricier than Chinatown.
quotes: Incredible value, best "bang for the buck" in the neighborhood.
They have big portions for fair prices. Constantly clean and with good character.

themes.label: Rude or poor service
themes.text: Several reviewers describe rude staff, mishandled orders and unhelpful responses to mistakes, though others find the staff friendly.
quotes: Always rushing on the phone. They are very rude.
They Messed My Order Up Then Didnt Want To Fix It.

themes.label: Food quality and flavor
themes.text: Opinions split: some find the food fresh, tasty and well fried, while others call it bland, greasy, gristly or poorly cooked.
quotes: Fresh and tasty lo mein and egg fu young.
The beef was inedible All of it. It was fatty a full of gristle.

themes.label: Fast delivery
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly mention that delivery arrives very quickly, often with the food still hot.
quotes: Incredibly fast delivery service which can seem to have the food at your door before you even finish ordering it.
The food has always arrived quickly and still hot.

themes.label: Noise and cleanliness
themes.text: Some mention loud high school students and an unclean look, while others find the place clean, neat and pleasant.
quotes: Very noisy during 11-4:30 due to high school students camping out inside
Nice and neat place with good food.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Most reviewers describe the staff as friendly, professional, attentive and quick, though a few report rude hosts, lousy service or a messed-up order.
quotes: Excellent service and a very competitive price. The food is also excellent.
Hosts are rude, reservations are delayed in seating, the menu has shrunken so far as to be McGreek food

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Many call the prices fair or good value, while others say it is overpriced or a bit pricey for what you get.
quotes: great simple food. great value.
Finally a little too expensive for what it's worth, but overall good place.

themes.label: Food quality and freshness
themes.text: Most praise the fresh, tasty food, but some find it merely decent, bland or uninspired, and a few dishes disappointed.
quotes: Everything tasted fresh, even in the middle of January. Try the tomato salad.
Nice people. Bland, uninspired food. Depressing ambience.

themes.label: Mezze, dips and octopus
themes.text: Dips, spreads, feta and grilled octopus are repeatedly singled out as delicious highlights.
quotes: The Barrel aged feta is one of the most delicious things I've ever eaten in my life.
very creamy octopus and the roasted chickpeas were so good! if you come here, def get the octopus

themes.label: Atmosphere and space
themes.text: Reviewers like the cozy, relaxed, lively room, but others find the ambience dark or depressing, and the downstairs less vibrant.
quotes: Jovial crowd, nice vibe in a cozy basement location.
we were sat downstairs en route to the restrooms - bit of a different vibe down there

themes.label: Friendly attentive service
themes.text: Most reviewers praise friendly, quick and attentive staff, but a few describe a hostile server, upselling, being rushed, and slow requests for olive oil.
quotes: Service was absolutely amazing! The staff was kind and the food and dessert was high quality.
Felt like the server was hostile and did not want us there.

themes.label: Fair reasonable prices
themes.text: Many reviewers say the prices are reasonable or affordable for Manhattan, and some mention the cheap lunch, early prix fixe and brunch.
quotes: Prices are quite reasonable for Manhattan! I would highly recommend Bella Luna
Excellent food, prix fix early menu was a great deal.

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Most reviewers call the food delicious and fresh, especially the pasta and pizza, but some found it average, bland, undercooked or poor.
quotes: Classic Italian food in a new, modern setting. The pasta is always excellent.
The pasta was meh.. Sauce was nothing special

themes.label: Atmosphere and seating
themes.text: Reviewers describe a relaxed, cozy, neighborhood setting with a modern new space, outdoor seating and a family-friendly feel.
quotes: Friendly staff and a warm cozy atmosphere highlight this UWS Italian spot.
Delicious food in a very relaxed, yet elegant setting.

themes.label: Small portions
themes.text: A few reviewers found the ravioli portion tiny, while another found lunch portions more than enough and one called the food plentiful.
quotes: Very good dishes but the ravioli portion is tiny
Some have complained of small portions but both were more than enough for lunch

themes.label: Authentic homemade pasta and pizza
themes.text: Reviewers praise the homemade pasta and pizza as authentic and delicious, though a few found the food merely okay or too rich.
quotes: the pizzas are original and tasty, and the pasta dishes are hearty and authentic
Fresh ingredients, homemade pasta, flavorful and great wine menu.

themes.label: Cash only policy
themes.text: Many note the restaurant takes only cash; most accept it as a minor inconvenience, but some were caught out or annoyed.
quotes: Cash only is my only complaint, a bit of an inconvenience these days especially with that large of a bill.
We were not told cash only when we walked in and there were no signs in the front that says so.

themes.label: Owner and service
themes.text: Many praise the hands-on, friendly owner and attentive staff, while others describe rude staff, a pushy owner or a rude manager.
quotes: Owner is wonderful and greets guests with a smile and friendly discussions.
Waiters are rude and act put upon to deliver cheese or crushed red pepper and don't check back.

themes.label: Crowded, no reservations
themes.text: The small, tightly packed room is often busy with waits and no reservations; some find it cozy and fun, others noisy.
quotes: It's a noisy and vibrant place and you'll bump elbows with your neighbors but it's just perfect.
the place is very small. If you come here during the peak time, it's likely that you have to wait for a while.

themes.label: Reasonable prices
themes.text: Several reviewers find prices low for good Italian food and wine, though a couple felt it was pricey for what they got.
quotes: Prices are very affordable for Italian food in nyc.
Food is ok for how expensive it is but nothing special.

themes.label: Huge generous portions
themes.text: Many reviewers say portions are very large and shareable, with some warning not to over-order, though a few note the food is very heavy.
quotes: Any one dish will easily serve 2, perhaps 4. Be warned.
Portions are huge. Don't over order

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Most reviewers praise friendly, attentive staff, but some report slow food, a pushy server, and reservations not being honored.
quotes: Great food, attentive service.
Waited over an hour for food. Terrible service.

themes.label: French dip sandwich
themes.text: The French dip, especially the classic or deluxe version with au jus, is repeatedly called great and a must-order.
quotes: The French Dip is to die for.
I tried the French dip sandwich as well which was super moist and the au jus was well-balanced.

themes.label: Cocktails and drinks
themes.text: Reviewers like the creative, well-made cocktails and bartenders, though one review says a drink was not delivered as advertised.
quotes: Cocktails were made by people who knew what they were doing.
Great bartenders with original ideas for cocktails

themes.label: Atmosphere and comfort
themes.text: Many like the chic decor and lively vibe, but others find it too dark, noisy, hot, or tightly seated.
quotes: the restaurant was too dark, too noisy and too hot.
Fun cocktails and very chic atmosphere

themes.label: Friendly attentive service
themes.text: Most reviewers praise friendly, attentive, accommodating staff, though a few describe awkward or mediocre service, rude staff and a billing problem.
quotes: Our waiter was really attentive and nice. Highly recommended!
However staff was rude, and when I checked my statement after having paid by credit card

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Many call prices decent, fair or good value, while several others find the restaurant pricey or overpriced.
quotes: Delicious and reasonably priced ramen and they have many different options, even rice bowls if you're not feeling ramen.
Ramen was really meh and pork buns were nothing special and it is very overpriced.

themes.label: Waits and crowding
themes.text: Reviewers say the small restaurant is busy, noisy and often has waits, though the electronic waitlist is praised and some find the wait worthwhile.
quotes: The wait can get pretty long (30 mins-1hr) on Friday and Saturday nights because the restaurant is pretty small, but it's worth it.
Love the iPad at the front where you enter your name and mobile # to get on the waitlist

themes.label: Generous ramen portions
themes.text: Reviewers describe large, filling portions of ramen and other dishes.
quotes: Ramen bowls are huge. It can feed 2.
The portions are really big and the dishes are really good.

themes.label: Volcano and spicy ramen
themes.text: Spicy ramens such as the volcano and spicy tonkatsu are singled out as flavorful favorites.
quotes: The volcano ramen is so good! I like the soup which is full of flavor and spicy.
The pork broth is just so masterfully done.

themes.label: Staff friendliness and rudeness
themes.text: Many reviewers praise friendly, prompt staff, while others describe rude waitresses, dismissive phone and delivery staff, and cold or impatient service.
quotes: Warm and friendly service.
Extremely rude staff. They act as if they are doing you a favor by serving you or taking your order.

themes.label: Reasonable prices and lunch specials
themes.text: Reviewers often call prices reasonable or good value, and frequently single out the lunch specials, though a couple find it overpriced or note extra charges.
quotes: If you go here for lunch you can I have three rolls for $13 with a soup or salad.
Amazing food at an amazing price!

themes.label: Sushi and food quality
themes.text: Most reviewers find the sushi fresh and delicious, but some call the food average or poor, citing stale seaweed and rubbery chicken.
quotes: The sushi was fresh and reasonably sized. The rice was cooked properly, not too sweet, and not mushy.
The seaweed was stale and the California roll was just fake crab and avocado with stale seaweed.

themes.label: Delivery and wait problems
themes.text: Several reviewers report unhelpful phone handling, a very long delivery wait, and a rude delivery person who demanded a bigger tip.
quotes: Stated 30-40 minute wait time, took 2+ hours, called twice with no explanation
They just dropped my call when I called with a question

themes.label: Cozy neighborhood atmosphere
themes.text: Reviewers describe a small, quiet, cozy neighborhood spot, though one says seating is too close and another finds little ambiance.
quotes: definitely a hole-in-the-wall, but in the best way.
Small, peaceful, 4 stars because the seating is to close

themes.label: Pizza quality
themes.text: Pizza is the most praised item, often called among the best in NYC, though a few found it overpriced, salty or with burnt crust.
quotes: One of the best pizzas I've had in NYC.
the pizza was perfection. Kale salad was also delicious.

themes.label: Friendly attentive service
themes.text: Most reviewers describe staff as friendly, attentive and welcoming, though a few report a rude hostess or being rushed.
quotes: Incredibly helpful and friendly staff
Service top notch, casually attentive.

themes.label: Happy hour deals
themes.text: Happy hour is widely praised for good value on pizza, food and drinks, but one reviewer found the portions too small.
quotes: Unbelievable food and drinks for half the money.
Quantities are so small that you can't even have a proper dinner by taking everything on their menu.

themes.label: Pasta and appetizers
themes.text: Pastas and starters such as fried olives, arancini and meatballs are described as delicious, with one complaint of an overly salty bolognese.
quotes: The Meyer lemon linguinetti is to die for.
I ordered a pasta dish with a bolognese sauce which was incredibly salty.

themes.label: Prices
themes.text: Some reviewers call prices reasonable or good value, while others find the pizza expensive outside happy hour.
quotes: Kind of expensive for what this place offers.

themes.label: High prices
themes.text: Many reviewers call the food overpriced for its size and quality, though a few say it is reasonable or worth the cost.
quotes: It's just unacceptably expensive and not that good. Burritos are $20 and small, not much in them, lacking good flavors.
perfectly passable Mexican food, but at oddly exorbitant prices given the quality and the neighborhood

themes.label: Margaritas and tequila
themes.text: Reviewers praise the margaritas, especially the frozen and rainbow ones, and the tequila selection, with one complaint about a drink with almost no tequila.
quotes: Margaritas to die for especially the rainbow one.
The flavor was great but there was no tequila, or if there was, it was only a splash.

themes.label: Service speed and attentiveness
themes.text: Many describe friendly, excellent servers, but others report slow service, long waits, wrong orders, or being rushed.
quotes: Our waiter was excellent and attentive.
the service is slow and one time we waited over an hour and left.

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Many call the food good or great, while others find dishes bland, poorly cooked, or merely average.
quotes: Chicken taco was bland. The fish taco was decent. The rice and beans were disgusting. Pork taco was good.
i went early in the afternoon for lunch and i really enjoyed the food

themes.label: Patio and atmosphere
themes.text: Reviewers like the patio, sidewalk seating, and relaxed, family-friendly atmosphere.
quotes: Lovely interior and large patio. Great food.
Great sidewalk seating area. Kid friendly.

themes.label: Board games
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly praise the large selection of board games and table games, which make the bar fun for groups; one finds it a poor place to play.
quotes: Huge selection of board games, friendly staff and good atmosphere.
board games littered(good way) around the room. Pick one up and ask a stranger to play.

themes.label: Friendly staff and bartenders
themes.text: Staff and bartenders are described as friendly, welcoming, fast and personable, with only a couple of lukewarm service remarks.
quotes: Friendly staff, good menu, great service
the bartenders were really friendly too!

themes.label: Burgers and happy hour
themes.text: Cheap happy hour burgers and drinks are widely praised, though one reviewer reports getting sick after eating the burger.
quotes: Cheap and delicious. Happy hour burgers are amazing.
The burger is near guaranteed to keep you up all night in writhing stomach pain.

themes.label: Noise and crowding
themes.text: Several reviewers say the bar gets loud and crowded, making conversation difficult, and some find seating limited or poorly arranged.
quotes: it is super loud in the evening, basically you need yo scream to have a conversation.
Sit in the backroom... if you want to hear... or talk...

themes.label: Fun relaxed atmosphere
themes.text: Many reviewers enjoy the laid-back, fun vibe, music and decor, and describe it as a good place to hang out with friends.
quotes: laid back but fun atmosphere, great music playing on their speaker system and a very friendly staff.
Chill atmosphere, not too loud, casual attire.

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the food, especially pasta and Italian dishes, calling it delicious, authentic and excellent, though a few found dishes average or bad.
quotes: The food here is amazing, they make their pasta here, it's delicious!
I have never eaten better pasta in my life!

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Staff are widely described as friendly, attentive and welcoming, though one reviewer found service green or slow and another had a rude billing dispute.
quotes: The staff is very accommodating and helped us choose the best dishes on the menu.
Very rude and ruined our lovely dinner.

themes.label: Pizza
themes.text: Some call the pizza the best in New York, while others found the margherita plain, basic or dry.
quotes: Best pizza in NYC. Great take out!
Ordered the margarita pizza which was just a plain pizza with one piece of basil on it.

themes.label: Prices and portions
themes.text: Many find prices reasonable, but some say it is pricey and portions are small.
quotes: Welcoming staff, outdoor sitting and super reasonable prices.
A little pricey but what you would expect for NYC.

themes.label: Ambience and atmosphere
themes.text: Reviewers describe the restaurant as cozy, romantic and relaxed, with nice decor and music, though it is small.
quotes: Romantic and relaxed environment.
Is is a very cozy restaurant with fantastic music selection.

themes.label: Roasted and grilled chicken
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the chicken as juicy, fresh and delicious, but a few found it dry, burnt or tasteless.
quotes: The 1/2 chicken was delicious. So juicy and well seasoned. It was a massive portion and it lasted me for two days.
This chicken is here is very very dry, beyond dry, careless, only flavor is "burnt"

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Many call it cheap or reasonably priced for generous food, while others say prices rose and it is pricey.
quotes: A quarter of chicken with a salad, pita, side, and soda came to only $8.
They got greedy and raised their prices so much, can't afford to come her anymore.

themes.label: Speed of service
themes.text: Most describe fast, quick service and delivery, though some report long waits, crowding and confused orders.
quotes: But it is always busy. The food is skimpy in terms of portions. Long wait.

themes.label: Portion sizes
themes.text: Reviewers frequently describe portions as large and plentiful, with one dissenting review calling the food skimpy.
quotes: Huge portions and bottled sauces at the table
A lot of food for the price.

themes.label: Staff friendliness
themes.text: Most mention friendly, efficient staff, but one tourist found the order-taking staff rude and another found employees rushed.
quotes: the staff who took our order at checkout was perhaps the rudest we encountered in New York

themes.label: Beer selection
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly praise a large, varied beer list, including drafts, craft and rotating choices, with only occasional complaints about warm beer.
quotes: The beer selection is truly amazing. Many different styles and breweries.
Huge collection of draft beers, changing seasonal. Outdoor seating great for summertime.

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Most reviewers describe friendly, fast, helpful staff, but several report rude, slow or ignoring bartenders.
quotes: Outstanding service, great food.
the bartender's ignored me for over ten minutes. There were seven people at the bar total so no excuse.

themes.label: Burgers
themes.text: Burgers, including bison, lamb and tuna steak versions, are frequently described as good or excellent.
quotes: The bison burger was excellent and I'll probably be back soon to try another.
The burger had fantastic structure and it didn't fall apart.

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Many call the food good or great, including wings, but some find it only so-so, and nachos and mac-n-cheese bites drew complaints.
quotes: their wings are AMAZING. Definitely easily the best you will get in the UWS.
Good beer selection but the food is so-so.

themes.label: Atmosphere and outdoor seating
themes.text: Reviewers like the comfortable, neighborhood feel and outdoor tables, though a few cite noise, poor TV placement or lack of atmosphere.
quotes: Family-friendly during the day, with great outdoor seating, and a fun place to hang out until the wee hours of the morning.
Way to loud...!!! Cosy decor and nice beer selection.

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Most reviewers praise friendly, attentive staff and great service, but a few describe rude treatment, slow waits, seating problems and poor handling of mistakes.
quotes: Excellent service and staff. Very authentic food. The best in NYC.
They acted like it was our fault and did not seem to care to make it right.

themes.label: Coffee and breakfast
themes.text: Reviewers often praise the coffee, pastries and breakfast or brunch dishes such as poached eggs.
quotes: Coffee is delicious enough to drink black and the cream Bomboloni is light and delightful.
Awesome coffee and breakfast! Poached eggs great

themes.label: Italian wine selection
themes.text: Reviewers like the Italian wine list, fair glass prices and the bar as a place for a drink.
quotes: Solid Italian wine selection and knowledgeable staff to help you pick.
The best wine bar in the Upper West side

themes.label: Pasta and main dishes
themes.text: Many enjoyed dishes like spaghetti, lasagna, duck ragu and salmon, while others found food bland, hard meatballs, stale greens or frozen-tasting pasta.
quotes: the duck ragu is the best plate of pasta you will ever eat.

themes.label: Prices and portions
themes.text: Several reviewers found the prices high for the portions, especially pasta, though one called pasta moderately priced and another gave generous panini portions.
quotes: the portion was insanely small for $30.
Food is doable. On the pricey side.

themes.label: Staff friendliness and attitude
themes.text: Many reviewers found staff friendly and welcoming, while others described them as rude, unmotivated, poorly trained or inattentive.
quotes: The workers are much nicer than most Chipotles
Some look like their there just for the work and are not very welcoming.

themes.label: Skimpy portion sizes
themes.text: Reviewers complained that servers give small portions of meat and other ingredients, sometimes at normal prices or with an extra charge for more.
quotes: Servers are stingy with the portion sizes.
they made us tiny portions and charged the normal rate... not cool.

themes.label: Cleanliness of the restaurant
themes.text: Some reviewers called the place clean, while others reported dirty floors, dirty counters, full garbage containers or a general lack of cleanliness.
quotes: Clean and the line wasn't long when I went.
Looks like it hasn't been swept or cleaned all day.

themes.label: Speed of service
themes.text: Most reviewers praised quick lines and fast service, but some found the staff slow or busy with online orders.
quotes: With quick moving lines and food that is both fresh and delicious, this Chipotle branch is the place to go for any meal.
The problem here is the staff. They work super slow and very unprofessional.

themes.label: Food quality and freshness
themes.text: Most reviewers enjoyed the tasty, fresh food, though a few reported spoiled lettuce, a rock in a bowl, or changed flavors.
quotes: Really liked the food but a little on the expensive side because the ingredients are so fresh.
the lettuce in my burrito was spoiled.

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Most reviewers call the food delicious or great, praising pasta, burrata, cauliflower and chicken milanese, though a few found dishes mediocre or the pizza disappointing.

quotes: Taco prices are on par with a taco truck, which is pretty impressive for a sit down restaurant with table service.
Decent food but too pricey and the staff didn't quite know how to make guests feel welcome.

themes.label: Space and atmosphere
themes.text: Reviewers like the large, spacious, clean, playful Mexican-market feel and family-friendly setting, though one found it loud, hot and dark.
quotes: It has a very "Mexican market" feel which really stands out against the rest of the NYC landscape.
Cool and upbeat place for tacos - new to UWS. Spacious and clean.

themes.label: Drinks and juices
themes.text: Margaritas, mezcal, aguas frescas and fresh juices are repeatedly praised, though one reviewer was disappointed that the horchata was not handmade and others found drinks pricey.
quotes: Love it.. the margarita was ON POINT!
Watermelon juice was great (with lime!).

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Most reviewers praise friendly, attentive and helpful staff, though one reviewer describes confused orders and double charges, and another felt upsold.
quotes: Warm and caring waitstaff!
Amazing service, the menu has a flavor for every palate.

themes.label: Hummus, bread and dishes
themes.text: Hummus, the fresh-baked bread, spicy feta and lamb dishes are repeatedly singled out as standouts.
quotes: Hummus plate is next level!
That bread fresh from the taboon oven is amazing, especially with spicy feta.

themes.label: Price and portions
themes.text: Many find it pricey for what is served, with one saying portions shrank and prices doubled, though a few call prices fair or reasonable.
quotes: You pay $7 for a tablespoon of hummus- and I wish that was an exaggeration.
Ended up paying like $27 for some eggs in a tomato gravy.

themes.label: Outdoor garden seating
themes.text: Reviewers like the back garden, courtyard and patio in warm weather, though one found the heated tent cold.
quotes: Sit outside. It's amazing out back.
Backyard is heated and tented but cold.

themes.label: Atmosphere and noise
themes.text: The ambiance is often called warm, cozy or relaxed, while one reviewer found it too noisy for conversation and another found it a tight squeeze.
quotes: noisy difficult to have a conversation
The music is not too loud and atmosphere is relaxed.

themes.label: Atmosphere and decor
themes.text: Many reviewers praise the lively, authentic Irish pub feel, the decor and the relaxed mood.
quotes: Great bar, very authentic decor. Loved it the staff are great, lovely food and fantastic atmosphere
Excellent atmosphere in an amazing place in NY

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Some find the food delicious or good pub fare, while others call it average, disappointing or even inedible.
quotes: It's really hard to mess up fish and chips and they did not.
Good service, bad food. Hockey puck burgers and soggy fish and chips.

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Many describe friendly, attentive bartenders and staff, but others report being ignored, slow service or inattentive waiters.
quotes: Great place and amazing staff. Definitely didnt expect this kind of hospitality and kindness in NYC.
No acknowledgement with 15 mins, I'm out.

themes.label: Outdoor seating
themes.text: Outdoor seating on Stone Street is repeatedly named as a major draw.
quotes: Great outdoor space and service in the heart of downtown.
Outdoor seating on stone street, decent bar food and drinks.

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Several reviewers feel the pub is overpriced for the quality of food, though a few find prices acceptable.
quotes: Fun spot but really over priced for quality of food
The prices are slightly above average for NYC but it's Stone Street

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Most reviewers describe friendly, fast, attentive staff, though a few mention brusque or ignoring servers and slow ordering.
quotes: service was quick, friendly and attentive
We were ready to order and caught her eye but she just ignored and left us along.

themes.label: Prices
themes.text: Some find prices reasonable, while others call the restaurant overpriced for a diner or coffee shop.
quotes: Great service and reasonable prices, diner style American food.
Just OK. Way over priced. Small OJ made from frozen ..was $4.50!

themes.label: Breakfast and menu variety
themes.text: Reviewers praise the breakfast and the extensive diner menu with many options.
quotes: their selection of breakfast foods was amazing
We visited several times for breakfast during our week in New York and tried various options from the menu - all were great

themes.label: Portion sizes
themes.text: Several reviewers say portions are large and filling, with one finding it almost too much food.
quotes: They serve huge portions of tasty food and a big variety of drinks.
Almost too much food, though.

themes.label: Food safety and quality complaints
themes.text: A few reviewers report food poisoning, stale or bland items, or poorly cooked dishes.
quotes: Got food poisoning after having their chocolate mousse cake.
Burger gave my friend food poisoning

themes.label: Unlimited sangria brunch
themes.text: Many reviewers praise the brunch deal with unlimited sangria in many flavors, though one found drinks slow and another noted that one person being cut off affects the group.
quotes: Buy any entrée and enjoy unlimited (that's right – actually unlimited) sangria of any kind (and you can switch back and forth) for up to two solid hours.
Bottomless brunch was worth every penny! Food proportion is huge!

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Most reviewers call the food delicious or amazing, while some find it only ok, mediocre, not fresh or underwhelming.
quotes: The only part I didn't like was the food itself which was barely hispanic and no more than mediocre
Finally got to experience their dinner menu and it was just as good.

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Staff are usually described as friendly, fast and attentive, but a few reviewers report slow service, unfriendly waiters or yelling.
quotes: The waiters were prompt and never let a glass get empty.
The service was a bit slow and our two waiters were definitely not friendly.

themes.label: Lively atmosphere
themes.text: Reviewers describe a fun, happening, warm room with great music, though a few say the seating feels crowded.
quotes: you feel like you're at a party and everyone is having a fun time.
Seating setup could have been a little more spacious inside.

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Some say prices are good or worth it, while others find the restaurant pricy or note that prices have risen.
quotes: The drinks are around $12-$14 and the main dishes are ~ $30. A bit pricy for what it is.
Good food! Well worth the price.

themes.label: Beer selection
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly praise a large, varied beer list including draft and Belgian beers, though one says the alcohol selection is weak.
quotes: Great beer list. Has a jukebox, aquarium, board games, high tops and two divey bathrooms.
Large selection of draft beers.

themes.label: Friendly bartenders
themes.text: Most reviewers describe bartenders and staff as friendly, attentive and fun, though a few report uneven or poor service.
quotes: The bar tender was very attentive even with the large crowd.
Relaxed and comfortable place, some bartenders offer better service than others

themes.label: Board games and extras
themes.text: Board games, free candy and the fish tank are frequently cited as fun touches, though one finds the room too dark to play and another says games are worn.
quotes: Halloween candy, fish tank, board games, this place has it all and it's a bar!
Board games are mostly old and missing pieces.

themes.label: No food served
themes.text: The bar serves no food beyond candy, which some regret, though many note you can bring in or order delivery.
quotes: No food (other than candy), but you're allowed to bring your own
Nice selection of beer, sadly they do not server food.

themes.label: Crowding
themes.text: Several reviewers say the bar gets crowded quickly, making ordering slow and seating hard to find.
quotes: Gets crowded too fast and that downgrades the experience.
Very crowded couldn't even find a place to sit or order drinks

themes.label: Margaritas and drinks
themes.text: Reviewers frequently praise the margaritas, including strong, spicy and tower versions, and the drinks generally, though a couple find prices high.
quotes: The margarita was very strong which was a plus since you didn't need to drink multiple to feel good.
Spicy Margaritas to die for.

themes.label: Guacamole and chips
themes.text: Guacamole, often made tableside, is repeatedly singled out as a favorite, with one reviewer calling it the best in the city.
quotes: They have THE BEST guacamole in nyc.
Really good margaritas and great tableside guacamole.

themes.label: Lively atmosphere
themes.text: Many describe a fun, festive, colorful space with good music and a patio, though one finds it too dark and some find it loud.
quotes: Good is good and it's fun atmosphere.
The atmosphere is very fast paced and lively!

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Some found friendly, fast service, while others reported rude staff, long waits for servers, and incomplete orders.
quotes: Great service. Awesome ambiance
food is ok, staff were a bit rude.

themes.label: Crowds and waits
themes.text: The restaurant is often crowded, with long waits for tables noted, though a few say the food is worth it.
quotes: Always crowded, standard Mexican
It was extremely crowded on Friday afternoon, but worth the wait

themes.label: Banana pudding
themes.text: Banana pudding is the most praised item, repeatedly called the best or a must-order, with one reviewer finding it too heavy after a few bites.
quotes: The most amazing banana pudding I've ever had!!!!!
Banana pudding is the thing to get!

themes.label: Staff friendliness and service
themes.text: Many describe friendly, helpful staff, but several report inattentive, unhelpful or rude employees who ignored customers.
quotes: Fantastic, friendly service. Be sure to check out the additional seating off to the back right.
I've never received such terrible service from so many employees in one place.

themes.label: Cupcake sweetness and quality
themes.text: Some love the cupcakes, while others find them too sweet, with heavy frosting and unremarkable flavor.
quotes: In my opinion they are far too sweet to taste any subtleties in the different flavors.
German chocolate cupcakes were to die for!!

themes.label: Prices
themes.text: Several reviewers call it expensive, while others say prices are good or low for the quality and for NYC.
quotes: Like every other cupcake joint where that is their sole product, it is over priced.
Low prices for NYC

themes.label: Cakes and cheesecakes
themes.text: Cakes and cheesecakes, including chocolate, caramel and pistachio varieties, earn strong praise as moist and delicious.
quotes: Chocolate cake with chocolate butter cream frosting was the best I've ever had
Pistachio cheesecake was amazing.

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the food as delicious or excellent, though a few call it average, overpriced for its quality, or disliked it.
quotes: The food was amazing, wonderful experience. Totally worth it
Honestly now I feel like the place is a little bit overpriced for the quality of the food.

themes.label: Brunch dishes
themes.text: Brunch items such as French toast, shakshuka, omelettes and waffles are widely praised, though pancakes were called not worth $14.
quotes: I've never had french toast that is so soft and buttery!

themes.label: Service and host
themes.text: Service is often called excellent or attentive, but others describe erratic, laggy or aloof service and an unpleasant host.
quotes: The staff was attentive and accommodating.
exceptional waiters, but unwelcoming host staff.

themes.label: Noise and crowding
themes.text: Several reviewers find the restaurant loud and crowded, especially on weekends, though some still call the atmosphere cozy.
quotes: The restaurant can get noisy when it's crowded.
Can't barely hear each other with the loud music.

themes.label: Beer and wine list
themes.text: Reviewers like the extensive beer and wine selection.
quotes: They have a great beer menu on-hand and they're pretty open to letting you taste whatever piques your interest.
Excellent steak tartare and great beer list

themes.label: High prices for the food
themes.text: Many reviewers call the restaurant expensive or overpriced, some saying the food is only average takeout quality, while a few accept the cost as luxury.
quotes: The food is okay, but the price just doesn't make sense.
this place charges insane prices for lower quality food than you would get at your local Chinese food takeout restaurant

themes.label: Food quality and consistency
themes.text: Some find the food delicious and classic, while others call it bland, mediocre or disappointing, and a few note it is inconsistent.
quotes: Fantastic Chinese food- Some of the best in the city!
Portions still large but incredibly bland.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Many praise attentive, excellent service, but others report slow, rushed, sporadic or rude service, including a tip demand.
quotes: the service was ridiculously slow from the servers
Staff was able to accomodate for my wife's allergies. superb service.

themes.label: Dim sum and cafe
themes.text: Reviewers like the dim sum, especially the carts, and the less formal, cheaper cafe, which is also convenient before Lincoln Center.
quotes: Lots of dim sum options that go around in carts.
The cafe is a wonderfully convenient place pre-Lincoln Center with fast service and generally delicious food.

themes.label: Dated decor and cleanliness
themes.text: Some admire the dragon and glamorous room, while others find it dated or dirty, with messy restrooms mentioned.
quotes: The place looked very dated and dirty.
Beautifully decorated with an amazing lit dragon

themes.label: Beer selection
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly praise the wide, rotating craft beer list, though one says it has shrunk in recent years.
quotes: I really like the rotating beer selection at the growler. They always bring something good
Best beer selection in the Financial District, food is good, but the menu doesn't change.

themes.label: Service and bartenders
themes.text: Many find staff friendly, attentive and fast, but others report slow, rude or inattentive service from bartenders and waiters.
quotes: The service at the Underdog was exceptional. Top notch.
Service was terrible. We were outside at the terrace and the two waiter and waitress that were serving out were constantly looking over us

themes.label: Food and menu
themes.text: Most praise dishes like poutine, French dip, sliders and tacos, but some find the menu bland, reduced or unremarkable.
quotes: One of the best French dips I've ever had!
a much smaller, blander menu

themes.label: Bloody Mary bar
themes.text: Reviewers enjoy the build-your-own Bloody Mary bar, finding it worthwhile and customizable.
quotes: Make your own bloody Mary's bar is worth a visit.
I specifically came here for the build-your-own Bloody-Mary bar and it was well worth the money!

themes.label: Crowds and atmosphere
themes.text: Reviewers like the cozy, lively Stone Street setting and outdoor seating, though several say it gets loud and packed.
quotes: Loud bar which tends to be crowded. If you can manage to get a seat, they've got a solid menu!
Pretty relaxed pub (although plenty of patrons) where you can actually have conversations.

themes.label: Sandwich quality
themes.text: Sandwiches are the most praised item, described as delicious, fresh and hearty, with specific favourites named, though a few found them dry or mediocre.
quotes: The spicy chicken sandwich is proper spicy and delicious
Very good fresh and hearty sandwiches for a ridiculous price including the $ 5 sandwich of the day

themes.label: Speed of service
themes.text: Most reviewers describe quick service even when busy, but a few report waits of 15 to 19 minutes for a sandwich.
quotes: Theyre always fast despite being constantly full!
Good sandwiches, abysmal wait time. Expect to wait 15 minutes for a sandwich.

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Some call prices cheap, fair or good value for large portions, while others find the restaurant pricey or note a recent price rise.
quotes: pricey but for the size of the sandwich it is reasonable
they just raised prices >10% (and everyone is worried about deflation) so the value isn't what it used to be.

themes.label: Staff and customer service
themes.text: Many reviewers praise friendly, attentive staff, but others report poor customer service, rude talk by staff and orders made wrong.
quotes: Super nice staff and super delicious and fresh breakfast.
Food is mediocre, costumer service is always lacking.

themes.label: Coffee quality
themes.text: Coffee drew mostly complaints, being called disappointing or watery, although a couple of reviewers liked the iced coffee and coffee in general.
quotes: it tasted like coffee with milk with water
The coffee was a bit disappointing though.

themes.label: Sandwich quality
themes.text: Many reviewers praise the sandwiches, including pastrami, chicken cutlet and fish, though one found the bagels bad and another said the sandwiches weren't good.
quotes: Best chicken cutlet sandwich I've had in a longgggg time. Highly recommend. Juicy and fresh and barely waited for the sandy.
Excellent pastrami sandwiches. Speedy service, no frills.

themes.label: Staff rudeness and phone service
themes.text: Several reviewers report rude staff who hang up on callers, yell, or are dismissive, and some delivery staff were also described as rude.
quotes: They are very nice in the store but extremely rude over the phone the man hung up on me 3 times on purpose
The staff were rude, they didn't bring everything we ordered, and they yelled at us when we called about it.

themes.label: Friendly, quick service
themes.text: Many reviewers describe fast, efficient and friendly in-store service and quick delivery.
quotes: Always quick service, always hits the spot.
Nice and efficient staff, they offer really good Caesar salads and cheeseburgers.

themes.label: Wide menu variety
themes.text: Reviewers like the large selection and the option to build your own sandwich or choose from a simple menu.
quotes: You can get pretty much everything here and the sandwiches are really good.
They have a ton of options and a simple menu.

themes.label: Prices
themes.text: Many call prices good or fair, while a few find the food pricey or say some items cost more than nearby places.
quotes: Excellent sandwiches at a great price
Pricey compared to other places in the neighborhood and they get the order wrong too often.

themes.label: Speed of service
themes.text: Many reviewers praise fast, efficient service, while others report slow service, long waits and long queues, especially when busy.
quotes: Very nice staff, very clean location, and exceptionally quick service.
Always astonished at how slow fast food can be here

themes.label: Cleanliness of the restaurant
themes.text: Some reviewers found the place clean, including the restroom, while others described dirty areas, uncleaned tables and dirty ordering kiosks.
quotes: Nice place, with air conditioning, it was clean and the internet is excellent
Average quality, crowded tables Not cleaned

themes.label: Staff friendliness
themes.text: Most reviewers describe friendly, respectful staff, but some found workers uninspired, unhappy about mistakes, or rude about closing.
quotes: Fast and efficient service. They have very friendly staff.
most of the people behind the counter are uninspired to take your order

themes.label: Seating and crowding
themes.text: Reviewers say the location is very busy, with crowded tables and often hard-to-find seating.
quotes: The wait is long but they do their best to get you your food quickly. There usually isn't a place to sit.

themes.label: Closing hours and restrooms
themes.text: Reviewers complain the restaurant closed in the early morning despite advertised 24-hour hours, and that restrooms were closed or locked.
quotes: At 4:30 the doors were open and i was told we're closed that's it. I asked aren't they 24hrs?

themes.label: Sushi freshness and quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise fresh, high-quality sushi and fish, though some say quality has dropped over time or taste was average and bland.
quotes: this is the freshest we've had in America. Not the cheapest however
Used to have fantastic in fresh sushi but something has changed. The quality of the food has significantly dropped

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Many reviewers find prices reasonable and lunch specials good value, with generous food for the cost, though one notes it is not the cheapest.
quotes: We got the lunch specials and got a lot of food for a low price, would recommend!
One of the top quality sushi places at affordable price in Manhattan!

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Many describe friendly, attentive staff, but others report slow, inattentive or unfriendly service and a surprise tip charge.
quotes: Extremely friendly and knowledgeable staff.
Quite literally the worst service I have ever experienced. On a relatively slow night, ignored for 20 minutes before my order was taken.

themes.label: Delivery experience
themes.text: Some praise fast, reliable delivery, while others describe missed or misdelivered orders, cold food and disputes over what was ordered.
quotes: Great food, incredibly reliable, whip fast delivery, I am very lucky they are in the area.
The food did not arrive on time. I called the restaurant and they told me they delivered the food.

themes.label: Space, noise and atmosphere
themes.text: Reviewers like the large, cozy space with seating options, but mention loud music, crowding downstairs and worn banquettes.
quotes: it's a massive space with high ceilings that's a very welcoming space.
Downstairs can be hot, crowded and especially noisy.

themes.label: Fish freshness and quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise fresh, high-quality sushi and sashimi, though a few say the fish was warm, smelly, not fresh or poor quality.
quotes: Freshest, highest quality sushi around.
Fish is terrible! Not fresh and smelly. The worst sushi I ever had

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Many describe attentive, friendly, fast service, but several reviewers found waitresses annoyed, service slow or only okay.
quotes: The waiters knew just when they were needed.
From the moment we walked in the waitress seemed annoyed with us, like she is doing us a favor...

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Most find prices reasonable and the omakase a great value, while a few call it overpriced or not worth the cost.
quotes: Also for $60 for the omakase, it's a steal!
It's expensive — it is tasty by I don't think the price justifies it.

themes.label: Chef's omakase
themes.text: Reviewers highly recommend the sushi chef's omakase and creative dishes, calling them excellent and memorable.
quotes: If you sit at the sushi bar and order the omikase, you're in for a life changing meal
the chef's creations (both on the menu and omakase) make this place a diamond.

themes.label: Portion sizes
themes.text: Reviewers describe portions as large or generous, particularly at lunch.
quotes: Great dumpling and generous sushi portions.
Clean, big portions and fresh and excellent service!

themes.label: Sushi quality and freshness
themes.text: Many praise fresh, delicious sushi, while others find it average, with dry or hard rice, small rolls or poor quality fish.
quotes: Generous cuts of fish and tastes very fresh.
The entire rice ball is hard as rock, from a sushi standard.

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Most reviewers describe friendly, attentive staff, but some report slow service, unfriendly servers or a grumpy greeter.
quotes: Very attentive staff and the food is great.
The servers aren't that friendly but the food was delicious.

themes.label: Pricing and value
themes.text: Reviewers often call it a bit pricey or expensive but worth it, while a few say it is reasonable and one calls it overpriced.
quotes: It's a little pricy but worth it.
pricing is affordable and the spot is always clean.

themes.label: Atmosphere and dining room
themes.text: Reviewers like the upscale, beautiful space and ambiance, though narrow booths and a cold room drew complaints.
quotes: very quiet restaurant, very competent service, beautiful surroundings
the booths are so narrow that you can't sit there comfortably

themes.label: Lunch and happy hour
themes.text: Reviewers value the spot for lunch and happy hour, citing fast service, decent portions and good deals.
quotes: Good spot for lunch. Service is pretty fast and portions are decent
Tasty happy hour deals on food at the bar until 7

themes.label: Smoothie taste and quality
themes.text: Reviewers disagree on the drinks: the acai smoothie and green juice combination were liked, while others found smoothies flavorless or chalky.
quotes: The acai smoothie was delicious but there are better places to go.
The smoothies with protein taste chalky.

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: One reviewer praised staff who stay open late for customers, while another reported terrible service, a bad attitude and a wrong order.
quotes: Staff is awesome and they even will stay open late if customers continue arriving.
The worst service ever. Terrible attitud. No clue how to provide a decent service.

themes.label: Opening hours mismatch

quotes: This store is not opened, even though Google Maps says it opens at 11.
The store doesn't open as advertised in Google.

themes.label: How healthy it is

quotes: It's not really healthy smoothies. It's a chain.
Great selection, healthy too.

themes.label: Small space, little seating
themes.text: Reviewers describe the store as unappealing and with barely any seating, more suited to grab and go.
quotes: Barely any room for seating . More of a grab and go place
Store is not particularly appealing.

themes.label: Cheap dollar slices
themes.text: Reviewers praise the very low prices, especially the dollar slice, and say the pizza doesn't taste cheap and beats pricier spots.
quotes: My favorite $1 slice in the city, doesn't taste cheap and the staff is very friendly
Way better then the overpriced ones in midtown or downtown.

themes.label: Overall pizza quality

quotes: This place has a dollar slice that can compete with the best in the city
not as good as 2 bros dollar slice.

themes.label: Sauce, cheese and freshness

quotes: Perfect sauce / cheese ratio.
Fresh out the oven slices. Delicious!

themes.label: Large slices
themes.text: One reviewer notes that the slices are huge for the price.
quotes: Best pizza I've had in awhile. And super affordable. Huge slices too.

themes.label: Pizza quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the pizza, often calling it among the best in the city, though one found a burnt crust and another oily pizza.
quotes: probably the best pizza in NYC!
Our favorite UWS pizza spot BY FAR and we've tried them all!

themes.label: Service and staff

quotes: The service was incredible and they were great at explaining their dishes
Don't expect top notch service. It is sporadic at best.

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Some find prices reasonable or decent for the area, while others call items pricey or say app prices did not match.
quotes: I would consider the prices high, however portions were large and food was good.

themes.label: Atmosphere and room

quotes: It has a very relaxing atmosphere.
Cozy, well served and delicious.

themes.label: Closures and online orders

This place is closed. But their website says that they are open

themes.label: Food quality

quotes: The Veal Parmigian was so tender, great flavor and huge portion.
The Pasta Fagioli was really tasty--particularly dunking their bread in it--and thePenne alla Vodka was exceptional

themes.label: Friendly attentive service
themes.text: Many reviewers describe the staff as friendly, accommodating and quick, though a few report problems with staff handling complaints or voucher rules.
quotes: The staff was kind, patient and good natured.

themes.label: Prices and tipping

quotes: The prices were also very reasonable, and the service was superb!
they charge you a 18% cause of service plus taxes so you finish paying a lot.

themes.label: Cozy neighborhood atmosphere

quotes: Cozy and dim with Godfather 70's vibe.

the staff is out of control rude

quotes: Very fast service. Friendly employees.
be willing to spend at least 15mins for your order!

quotes: Dirty tables and surroundings

quotes: the coffee is not outstanding but the donuts are incomparable.
donuts aren't that fresh, and coffee has a low quality taste.
